commands.stdout:
Native PDF text, metadata and citation extraction engine for academic corpora

Usage: tpe <COMMAND>

Commands:
  extract       Extract text, metadata and citations from PDF files into a ledger
  bibliography  Extract the final bibliography by reading PDF pages from the end
  stats         Print ledger statistics as `key: value` lines
  show          Show the latest run stored for a document hash prefix
  bench         Measure warm service time per 20-page chunk (no ledger writes)
  corpus        Manage the evaluation corpus described by a manifest
  eval          Evaluate extraction against `arXiv` `LaTeX` ground truth and write a report
  backends      List every known backend, whether it is compiled in, and whether it opens a one-page probe PDF (native libraries found)
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
